scenario: Authorized responder records an alias and restricted evidence reference
expected: Timeline and evidence are available only to the incident team
author: Defrixx

scenario: Attempt to include a raw secret in a ticket, scanner export or chat
expected: Further delivery is blocked; retain evidence in restricted storage and account for any disclosure that already occurred
author: Defrixx

scenario: A service credential is traced to its issuer, consumers and audit history
expected: Resource and time scope include inherited rights and derived access
author: Defrixx

scenario: Only the visible file is inspected; a derived session or shared consumer is omitted
expected: Scope remains incomplete with an owner and next investigation step
author: Defrixx

scenario: Responder applies the authorized procedure to test credentials and attempts a protected operation with the old version
expected: The protected operation with old credentials is denied; service impact is recorded
author: Defrixx

scenario: Team waits for all replicas to migrate while exposed credentials retain access
expected: Incident is not declared contained; escalate the remaining exposure and continuity decision
author: Defrixx

scenario: Issuer confirms revocation of the selected old credential
expected: A fresh authentication attempt using the old version is denied
author: Defrixx

scenario: Only the stored copy is deleted or the revocation API times out
expected: Revocation remains unconfirmed; verify issuer state and retain effective containment
author: Defrixx

scenario: Replacement is delivered to the selected workload through its approved secret mechanism
expected: The intended operation succeeds with scoped permissions and no secret in output
author: Defrixx

scenario: Replacement reuses the exposed value or is printed by the same debug path
expected: Replacement is rejected and the leak cause must be repaired
author: Defrixx

scenario: All inventoried consumers demonstrate successful use of the replacement
expected: Version evidence and a normal service operation cover every active consumer
author: Defrixx

scenario: A stale worker, environment variable or pool still uses the old version
expected: Recovery remains incomplete; the stale consumer is isolated or updated under the approved procedure
author: Defrixx

scenario: Pre-existing test sessions and newly attempted logins are checked independently
expected: Old access is denied or explicitly contained with measured remaining lifetime
author: Defrixx

scenario: Fresh login fails but an established session or derived credential still performs a protected operation
expected: Containment is not closed until that path is disabled or bounded by an approved residual-risk decision
author: Defrixx

scenario: Copy inventory records cleaned surfaces and protected retained evidence
expected: Residual copies have access restrictions, deadlines and owners
author: Defrixx

scenario: Latest commit is clean but an old artifact or clone still contains the value
expected: Cleanup remains open for that copy; revoked status and evidence retention remain separate
author: Defrixx

scenario: Recovery or rollback uses current authorized credentials
expected: Service works and the compromised version remains unusable
author: Defrixx

scenario: Restored configuration or rollback requests the exposed version
expected: Restore is blocked or isolated before reconnection; no old access is reactivated
author: Defrixx

scenario: A human reviews observed evidence and the repaired leak path
expected: Closure names completed stages and any bounded remaining work
author: Defrixx

scenario: Clean scan or successful deploy alone is used to close the incident
expected: Closure is withheld; missing issuer, session or consumer evidence is explicit
author: Defrixx
